BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Bayonne Energy Center is a gas-fired merchant generating facility in Bayonne, New Jersey, comprising BEC I, BEC II, and the dedicated cable connection into New York City's NYISO Zone J market.

The approximately 660 MW dual-fuel asset sells wholesale energy, capacity, and ancillary services and provides dispatchable support to a constrained urban load pocket. MSIP acquired the facility in October 2018 and sold its full interest on July 23, 2026 to Tunnel Energy Investor, an Elliott-managed buyer formerly named Jupiter Energy Investor. BEC III, a separately proposed battery project, is not part of this thermal-generation record.
